purpose: Qualify one self-contained, air-gapped mission-continuity node that maintains canonical local mission state, uses local models only for bounded proposals, preserves explicit authority through denied communications, survives bounded worker and interface failures, emits independently replayable receipts, and treats any Lattice integration as an optional membrane rather than the canonical substrate.

missionProfile.name: Disconnected Multi-Sensor Coordination
missionProfile.scenario: Asynchronous synthetic airspace-monitoring and logistics observations, duplicate and delayed reports, one bounded non-kinetic task, headquarters partition, local authority lease, compute-worker loss, interface drift, conflicting returning authority, after-action export, projection destruction and rebuild, and cold-successor replay.

invariants: local canonical mission state is independent of Lattice, AWS, model provider, UI, graph projection, query engine, and builder
models may propose and explain but may not grant authority, accept evidence, or self-promote output
lost communications do not imply unlimited local authority
returning authority does not silently overwrite local state
automatic pass does not create evaluator acceptance
failed or inaccessible workers cannot manufacture success or release locks without evidence
graph, SQL, cache, index, and UI surfaces remain destructible projections
interface drift refuses rather than improvises
real mode never falls back to or mixes synthetic custody
cold successor must answer what exists, what proves it, who may act, what remains unresolved, and what is safe next

existingPrimitiveMap.role: denied-communications authority, offline lease, partition, replay, and reconciliation runtime
separate automatic evidence from evaluator accept, reject, and defer disposition
schema-valid synthetic initialization, order, report, replay, and reconciliation evidence
deterministic delay, duplication, partition, and packet-custody fault lane
verified-only queue, plain-language custody receipt, and human-attributed review

requiredBehavior: publish only selected bounded local state
consume remote state without silent authority promotion
preserve exact external identifiers as external identifiers
continue local mission state when adapter is absent or disconnected
reconcile bounded deltas explicitly when connectivity returns

requires: zero external-service dependency in core path
zero operational credentials committed or required
canonical mission state survives removal of model, UI, graph, query engine, and optional Lattice membrane
every hostile scenario reaches an explicit terminal state
automatic failure or unauthorized request cannot become accepted
detached replay reproduces material state transitions
cold successor completes five-question recovery test
all artifacts reconstruct deterministically from exact accepted source
all excluded operational claims remain false
refuseIf: synthetic and real custody are mixed
model output is serialized as authority
automatic pass is serialized as evaluator acceptance
returning authority silently overwrites local state
Lattice adapter becomes required for local continuity
operational C2, targeting, engagement, effector, weapons, field-readiness, or representative-operator claims are generated
